full_prompt: Medium shot inside a dim Addis Ababa living room on a rainy afternoon: an Ethiopian mother in her late 40s, rich warm dark-brown skin, neat shuruba cornrows, white handwoven cotton habesha kemis with green-and-gold tilet neckline, kneeling and spreading fresh green ketema grass across the floor, a few small yellow daisies scattered in it, serene face looking down at her work.
